paragraphs.source_en: At the Battle of Yamazaki, Shōnyū had routed the Akechi commanders Matsuda Tarōzaemon and Saitō Kurō-no-suke in a single stroke, and the triumph had filled him with exhilaration. paragraphs.source_en: “I was only jesting.” With that, Shōnyū rose from the camp stool. Yet even he no longer knew what he had risen to do. He raised his head. All around him, the air was already filled with the chirping of small birds.

units.source_en: “I was only jesting.”
units.source_zh: “只是说笑罢了。”

units.source_en: With that, Shōnyū rose from the camp stool.
units.source_zh: 说着，胜入从床几上站了起来。

units.source_en: Yet even he no longer knew what he had risen to do.
units.source_zh: 可是究竟站起来干什么，就连他都弄不清楚了。

units.source_en: He raised his head. All around him, the air was already filled with the chirping of small birds.

ja.t: げると、あたりにはもう

units.source_zh: 他抬起头来，四面已经是一片小鸟的啁啾声了。

paragraphs.source_zh: “只是说笑罢了。”说着，胜入从床几上站了起来。可是究竟站起来干什么，就连他都弄不清楚了。他抬起头来，四面已经是一片小鸟的啁啾声了。
